theorems.name: Submission.p04_pb_60221840b0_noncentral_cancellation
theorems.statement: ∀ {k X : Type _} [CommRing k] (u v : X → X) (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 2) → X), let Q : ∀ m : ℕ, (Fin (m + 1) → X) → Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 2) → X) := fun m d j => Fin.insertNth j.castSucc (u (d j)) (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => if i < j then u (d i) else v (d i)); (∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ∑ a : Fin (n + 3) with a.val < j.val ∨ j.val + 1 < a.val, MonoidAlgebra.single (Q (n + 1) c j ∘ a.succAbove) ((-1 : k) ^ (j.val + a.val))) + (∑ b : Fin (n + 2), ∑ t : Fin (n + 1), MonoidAlgebra.single (Q n (c ∘ b.succAbove) t) ((-1 : k) ^ (b.val + t.val))) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Pairs noncentral prism faces with boundary prisms; corresponding tuples coincide and their signed coefficients cancel.
